reviews.author: David R.
reviews.text: Kash is hands down the best barber in Northwest Las Vegas. Unmatched precision on skin fades and razor lineups. The shop is always clean and welcoming.

reviews.author: Brandon M.
reviews.text: Great vibe in Centennial Crossroads Plaza. Marcus hooked me up with a crisp beard trim and hot towel shave. Found my go-to shop in 89131.

reviews.author: Greg S.
reviews.text: Top tier barbershop in Centennial Hills. Professional service, fair prices, and great attention to detail. Leo was great with my son's cut too.

faqs.q: Do you accept walk-ins or are appointments required?
faqs.a: Walk-ins are always welcomed daily during regular business hours! To guarantee immediate chair availability with Lead Barber Kash or your preferred barber, you can book online in advance via Booksy.

faqs.q: Where are you located and is there parking available?
faqs.a: We are located at 6420 Sky Pointe Dr #120, Las Vegas, NV 89131 inside Centennial Crossroads Plaza (near Sky Pointe Dr & N Tenaya Way). Free, spacious plaza parking is located directly in front of our shop.

faqs.q: Do you offer military or first responder discounts?
faqs.a: Yes! We proudly offer discounted haircuts ($35) for active and retired military personnel as well as first responders.
We accept all major credit/debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, AMEX, Discover), Apple Pay, Google Pay, Booksy direct pay, and cash.

faqs.q: What is included with a signature haircut?
faqs.a: Every signature haircut includes a consultation, precision clipper/scissor cut, hot lather razor neck cleanup, hair styling with premium products, and aftershave tonic.
